items.t: Costco: I'd Rather Spend $1,000 On Black Friday Than Buy Its Stock
items.sum: Analyst sees Costco Wholesale Corp. as overpriced at 47x earnings, with a 6.5% estimated return offering little risk upside versus Treasuries and the S&P 500.

items.t: 12 Big Funds Bought Costco Wholesale Last Quarter, While 7 Sold. Who’s Right?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysOf 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 12 bought Costco Wholesale and 7 sold, and the sellers moved far more money.

items.t: Costco Wholesale Corporation Stock: Is COST Outperforming the Consumer Staples Sector?
items.sum: Costco Wholesale’s shares have outpaced the consumer staples sector’s returns over the past three months, and analysts are moderately upbeat about the stock.

items.t: Costco: A Sector Rotation Is At Play, But Upside Remains Limited
items.sum: Costco Wholesale is rated Hold, observing the recent share rally to be a direct result of a broader sector rotation and capital outflows from the AI trade.

items.t: ETFs Bought $98.7 Million of Costco (COST) on Wednesday
items.sum: 38 ETFs bought Costco shares versus 18 that sold, for a net inflow of $98.7 million.

items.t: Black Friday TV Deals 2026: 65-Inch 4K TVs Drop Below $230, 100-Inch Screens Fall Under $1,000 at Walmart and Costco
